learning_outcomes.text: Possesses basic knowledge about the principles and application areas of manufacturing methods.
Possesses knowledge about the advantages, limitations, and application areas of manufacturing methods relative to each other.
Possesses the skill to identify and select equipment used in manufacturing methods.
Possesses the skill to select the most suitable manufacturing method during the design phase for a specific machine part.
Selects the operating parameters related to the manufacturing method to be used.

syllabus_topics: Classification of plastic forming methods, Mechanical and metallurgical fundamentals, plane strain and its effect on deformation, difference in plane stress
Hot, warm, and cold forming methods and their comparison. Applied annealing processes
Material behavior, Holloman equation, Johnson-Cook (JC) equation, its importance and application. Volume constancy in deformation and its consequences, Poisson's ratio.
Bulk and hot forming methods, rolling, definition of bite angle, its importance. Bolt production by rolling, ring rolling, seamless pipe manufacturing
Rolling problems, Introduction to forging, advantages and disadvantages of the method. Difference between hot and cold forging and its results, importance of flash line in closed-die forging
Extrusion methods, their disadvantages and advantages, wire drawing. Sheet metal working methods, cutting and analysis of cutting force.
Fine blanking, its advantages and differences in equipment. Bending process, springback effect and its reduction
Rolling direction, relationship to cracking in bending, example press brake applications, roll bending. Deep drawing, presses
Ironing and very deep drawing processes. Traditional spinning processes
High-velocity forming processes. Explosive, electrohydraulic, and electromagnetic forming
Hydroforming, transfer dies and press brake, turret press information
Introduction to powder metallurgy (PM), disadvantages and advantages of PM products, comparison with conventional methods
Additive manufacturing method, its basic advantages. STL method, laser-based layered manufacturing method, powder-based, selective laser sintering methods
assessment_rules: Midterm activities are weighted as follows: Midterm Exam 75%, Short Quiz 25%. The final grade is composed of 55% from the final exam and 45% from the in-year performance.
